info.name: GroupSync API
info.description:
Complete API documentation for GroupSync — location-based social platform.

## Quick Setup
1. Import this collection
2. Set `baseUrl` to `http://localhost:3000/api/v1`
3. Run Register or Login — tokens saved automatically
4. All authenticated requests use `{{accessToken}}` via collection-level Auth

## Variables
| Variable | Description | Auto-set |
|---|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | API base URL | No |
| `accessToken` | JWT (15 min) | Yes — Login/Register |
| `refreshToken` | Opaque token (30d) | Yes — Login/Register |
| `userId` | Auth user UUID | Yes — Login/Register |
| `targetUserId` | Another user UUID | No — set manually |
| `groupId` | Group UUID | Yes — Create Group |
| `groupSlug` | Group slug | Yes — Create Group |
| `applicationId` | Application UUID | Yes — Apply to Group |
| `inviteLinkId` | Invite link UUID | Yes — Generate Invite |
| `inviteToken` | Invite token string | Yes — Generate Invite |

## Response Envelope
```json
{ "success": true|false, "message": "string", "data": {}|[]|null, "error": null }
```
Paginated: includes `pagination: { page, limit, total }`

variable.description: Socket.IO server root — no /api/v1 prefix (e.g. http://localhost:3000 or https://group-sync-ovzh.onrender.com)

request.description: Verify the server is running. Returns environment and timestamp. No auth required.

response.name: 200 OK

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Registration, login, social OAuth, token management, password flows, email verification, KYC.

Rate limit: 10 req / 15 min per IP on all /auth/* routes in production.

request.description:
Create a new account.

Side effects: Email OTP queued via BullMQ. User created with id_verification_status=unsubmitted.

Password rules: min 8 chars, one uppercase, one lowercase, one digit.

phone: Stored AES-256 encrypted. Never returned in any response.

response.name: 201 Created
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Account created successfully. Please check your email to verify your account.",
  "data": {
    "user": {
      "id": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890",
      "email": "testuser@example.com",
      "displayName": "Test User",
      "username": null,
      "profilePhotoUrl": null,
      "bio": null,
      "city": null,
      "state": null,
      "country": "NG",
      "interests": [],
      "emailVerifiedAt": null,
      "idVerificationStatus": "unsubmitted",
      "status": "active",
      "lastLoginAt": null,
      "preferredLanguage": "en",
      "createdAt": "2026-05-03T16:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-05-03T16:00:00.000Z"
    }
  }
}

response.name: 409 Conflict — Email exists
422 Unprocessable — Validation failed

request.description:
Authenticate with email and password.

Requires email verification — returns 403 if the account email has not been verified yet.

Account lockout: 5 consecutive failures locks account for 15 min.
lastLoginAt updated on every successful login.

response.name: 200 OK
401 Unauthorized — Wrong credentials
403 Forbidden — Email not verified
429 Too Many Requests — Account locked

request.description:
Login or register via Google or Apple ID token.

Resolution flow:
1. Provider ID linked → sign in
2. Email exists, no link → link provider, sign in
3. Neither → create account + link, sign in

isNewUser=true triggers onboarding flow on client.
Apple returns 501 until Apple JWK verification is configured.

response.name: 200 OK
401 Unauthorized — Invalid token

request.description:
Revoke refresh token and session. Auth required.

Access token remains valid until 15-min TTL expires (stateless JWT).
Idempotent — already-revoked tokens return 200.
Clears presence:{userId} in Redis.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
Exchange refresh token for new token pair. No auth header needed.

Token rotation: old token atomically revoked — each token usable once only.
Call when access token expires (HTTP 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED).

response.name: 200 OK
401 Unauthorized — Invalid refresh token

request.description:
Request 6-digit OTP for password reset.

Always returns 200 regardless of email existence — prevents enumeration.
OTP TTL: 10 min (Redis: verify:forgot:{email}).

Flow: forgot-password → verify-forgot-otp → reset-password

response.name: 200 OK — Always returned

request.description:
Verify forgot-password OTP without DB changes.

Does NOT consume or extend the OTP — same OTP must be sent to reset-password.
Gate the new password UI behind a 200 from this endpoint.

response.name: 200 OK — OTP valid
400 Bad Request — OTP invalid/expired

request.description:
Confirm OTP and set new password.

Side effects: password updated, all refresh tokens revoked, failed login counter cleared, OTP deleted.

response.name: 200 OK
400 Bad Request — OTP invalid/expired

request.description:
Change authenticated user's password. Auth required.

Requires current password — use forgot-password flow if unknown.
Social-only accounts: returns 400 (no password set).

response.name: 200 OK
400 Bad Request — Wrong current password

request.description:
Verify email using OTP from registration or resend-verification.

On success, returns the user object and a token pair — this is the first point at which the client receives auth tokens.

Side effects: emailVerifiedAt set, OTP deleted, session created, welcome email queued.
OTP TTL: 10 min. No auth header needed.

response.name: 200 OK
400 Bad Request — Invalid/expired OTP

request.description:
Resend email verification OTP.

Always 200. Silently succeeds if already verified. Replaces previous OTP with fresh 10-min TTL.

response.name: 200 OK — Always returned

request.description:
Submit ID document for KYC. Uses standard authenticate (NOT authenticateVerified).

document_types: nin | voters_card | passport | drivers_license
document_url: HTTPS URL of file already uploaded to S3/R2

Document URL AES-256 encrypted before storage. Nulled after KYC decision.
Returns 409 if status already pending or verified.

response.name: 202 Accepted
409 Conflict — Already pending/verified

header.description: HMAC-SHA256 of raw body using KYC_WEBHOOK_SECRET

request.description:
Internal endpoint — called by KYC provider, not client app.

Signature: sha256=HMAC-SHA256(body, KYC_WEBHOOK_SECRET). Invalid → 401.
Idempotency: event_id cached in Redis 24hr. Duplicates silently ignored.

On approved: status=verified, document fields nulled, S3 cleanup queued, approval email sent.
On rejected: status=rejected, document fields nulled, rejection email sent.

response.name: 200 OK — Processed
401 Unauthorized — Invalid signature

item.name: Users
item.description:
Profile management, public profiles, interests, group memberships, applications, blocking.

Privacy rules:
- phone, phoneIv, passwordHash, idDocumentUrl, idDocumentIv — never returned
- email — only to owning user (GET /users/me)
- idVerificationStatus — only to owning user
- Block in either direction → GET /users/:id returns 404

request.description:
Full profile of authenticated user. Auth required.

Self-only fields: email, idVerificationStatus, emailVerifiedAt, lastLoginAt, preferredLanguage, state, country.
Never returned: phone, phoneIv, passwordHash, idDocumentUrl, idDocumentIv.

request.description:
Update group settings. Auth required. Role: admin or super_admin. All fields optional.

- `lat` + `lng`: both required together if provided

item.name: Memberships & Onboarding
item.description:
Joining, applying, leaving, application management, form configuration, member management, invite links.

Key rules:
- Verified users only for join, apply, accept invite
- Role hierarchy enforced on all member management actions
- super_admin cannot be removed or modified by admins
- Admins cannot modify other admins
- super_admin cannot leave if other members exist

request.description:
Join an open group instantly. Requires id_verification_status=verified.

Only works on membership_type=open groups.
Creates membership with role=member, status=active.
DB trigger increments member_count.
Notifies group admins via BullMQ.
409 if already a member. 403 if banned or group not open.

response.name: 201 Created
403 Forbidden — Not open group
409 Conflict — Already a member

request.description:
Submit application to an application-based group. Requires id_verification_status=verified.

Validates form_responses against group_forms.fields if a form exists.
Required fields that are missing return 422.
Re-application allowed if previous was rejected (old record deleted).
Notifies group admins via BullMQ.
409 if pending application exists.

response.name: 201 Created
403 Forbidden — Not application group
409 Conflict — Pending application exists
422 Unprocessable — Required fields missing

request.description:
Leave a group. Auth required.

Deletes membership row. DB trigger decrements member_count.
403 if super_admin and other active members exist (must transfer ownership first).
403 if not an active member.

response.name: 200 OK
403 Forbidden — Owner cannot leave

request.description:
Paginated application list for a group. Auth required. Role: admin or super_admin.

Includes applicant display_name, username, profilePhotoUrl.
Sorted by submittedAt DESC.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
Approve or reject a pending application. Auth required. Must be admin of the application's group.

On approve: membership created (role=member, status=active), applicant notified via email.
On reject: rejection_reason stored, applicant notified via email.
Only pending applications can be reviewed.
reviewedBy and reviewedAt set on action.

response.name: 200 OK — Approved
200 OK — Rejected
409 Conflict — Not pending

request.description:
Reject with a reason. Same endpoint as approve — just set action=reject and include rejection_reason.

rejection_reason is included in the notification email sent to the applicant.
Max 1000 characters.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
Withdraw own pending application. Auth required. Only the applicant can call this.

Sets status=withdrawn. Only pending applications can be withdrawn.
403 if caller is not the applicant. 409 if not pending.

response.name: 200 OK
409 Conflict — Not pending

request.description:
Get the application form schema for a group. No auth required (public).

Returns null data if no form configured for this group.
Field types: text | textarea | select | checkbox | radio
Each field: { id, type, label, required, options? }

response.name: 200 OK — Form exists
200 OK — No form configured

request.description:
Create or completely replace the application form. Auth required. Role: admin or super_admin.

This is a PUT (full replacement), not a PATCH.
Max 20 fields. Types: text | textarea | select | checkbox | radio.
For select/radio: options array required (max 20 items).
To delete the form: PUT with { "fields": [] }

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
Promote, demote, suspend, or ban a group member. Auth required. Role: admin or super_admin.

Role hierarchy rules:
- Cannot modify super_admin (403)
- Admin cannot modify another admin — only super_admin can (403)
- Can only assign roles BELOW your own rank (403)
- Caller must outrank target to modify them (403)

Can send role, status, or both.
roles: admin | moderator | member (cannot set super_admin via this endpoint)
statuses: active | suspended | banned

Notifies affected member via BullMQ.

response.name: 200 OK
403 Forbidden — Cannot modify super_admin
403 Forbidden — Admin vs admin

request.description:
Suspend a member. Same endpoint as role update — set status=suspended.

Suspended members cannot send messages or participate in the group.
Restored by setting status=active.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Ban a member. Banned members cannot re-join or re-apply to this group.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
Transfer group ownership by promoting another member to super_admin.

Only the current super_admin can do this.
After this: the caller becomes a regular admin, target becomes super_admin.
Required before super_admin can leave a group with other members.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
Remove a member from the group. Auth required. Role: admin or super_admin.

Deletes membership row. DB trigger decrements member_count.
Cannot remove super_admin. Admin cannot remove another admin.
Notifies removed member via BullMQ.

response.name: 200 OK
403 Forbidden — Cannot remove super_admin

request.description:
Generate a shareable invite link. Auth required. Role: admin or super_admin.

token: cryptographically random 64-char hex string.
inviteUrl: full URL for sharing (e.g. https://groupsync.app/invite/{token}).
max_uses: null = unlimited.
expires_in_hours: null = no expiry (max 8760 = 1 year).

Token cached in Redis (5 min TTL) for fast validation.
Expired links cleaned up by hourly cron job.

response.name: 201 Created

request.description:
List all active (non-revoked) invite links for a group. Auth required. Role: admin or super_admin.

Sorted by createdAt DESC. Does not include revoked links.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
Revoke an invite link. Auth required. Must be admin of the link's group.

Sets revokedAt=now. Removes from Redis cache.
409 if already revoked.

response.name: 200 OK
409 Conflict — Already revoked

request.description:
Join a group via invite link token. Requires id_verification_status=verified.

Token resolution: Redis cache first (5 min TTL), then DB fallback.
Validations: not revoked, not expired, use_count < max_uses.
Atomic: increments use_count + creates membership in single transaction.
409 if already a member. 410 if revoked/expired/max uses reached. 403 if banned.

response.name: 201 Created
410 Gone — Link revoked/expired/exhausted
409 Conflict — Already a member
404 Not Found — Invalid token

request.description:
Create an event in a group. Requires admin or super_admin role.

Body fields:
- `title` (string, required): max 200 chars
- `description` (string, optional)
- `location_name` (string, optional): venue name
- `lat` / `lng` (number, optional): venue coordinates stored as PostGIS Point
- `starts_at` (ISO 8601, required): must be in the future
- `ends_at` (ISO 8601, optional): must be after starts_at
- `rsvp_limit` (int, optional): max attendees with status `going`; null = unlimited

Side effect: queues `notify-group-members` BullMQ job to fan-out `event_created` notifications.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Lagos Tech Meetup",
  "description": "Monthly engineering meetup",
  "location_name": "Tech Hub Lagos",
  "lat": 6.5244,
  "lng": 3.3792,
  "starts_at": "2027-06-15T18:00:00.000Z",
  "ends_at": "2027-06-15T21:00:00.000Z",
  "rsvp_limit": 100
}

query.description: Filter by status: scheduled | cancelled | completed

request.description:
List events in a group. Non-members get a preview (scheduled events only). Members see all statuses.

Query params:
- `page`, `limit`: offset pagination

item.name: Socket.io / Chat
item.description:
Real-time events over Socket.IO namespace `/chat`.

## How to use in Postman
1. Open any request below — the URL already includes `?token={{accessToken}}`.
2. Click **Connect**. Postman establishes the Socket.IO handshake.
3. In the **Messages** tab, enter the **Event name** (shown in each request name) and paste the JSON body as the **Message**. Click **Send**.
4. Listen for incoming events in the **Messages** panel.

## Authentication
Token is passed as a query param: `?token={{accessToken}}`. Run Login first so `accessToken` is populated.

## Server → Client events
| Event | When fired |
|-------|------------|
| `new_message` | A new group message was sent |
| `message_deleted` | A group message was soft-deleted |
| `message_pinned` | A message was pinned/unpinned |
| `reaction_added` | Emoji reaction added |
| `reaction_removed` | Emoji reaction removed |
| `typing` | Another member is typing |
| `presence_update` | A user came online / went offline |
| `chat_lock_changed` | Group chat was locked/unlocked |
| `kicked_from_group` | You were removed from a group |
| `dm_received` | Incoming DM |
| `dm_read` | Receiver read your DMs |
| `error` | Error in processing your event |

request.description:
**Event name to emit:** `join_group`

Joins the socket to the `group:{groupId}` room. Must be an active member. All subsequent `new_message`, `typing`, `reaction_added`, etc. events for this group will be received.

**Payload:**
```json
{ "group_id": "<uuid>" }
```

**Error:** If not an active member → `error` event with `{ message: "Not an active member..." }`

**Event name to emit:** `leave_group`

Leaves the `group:{groupId}` room. You will no longer receive real-time events for this group.

**Payload:**
```json
{ "group_id": "<uuid>" }
```

**Event name to emit:** `send_message`

Send a message to a group room. Rate-limited: 10 messages per 10 seconds. Blocked if chat is locked and caller is not admin/super_admin.

**Payload:**
```json
{
  "group_id": "<uuid>",
  "content": "Hello!",
  "reply_to_id": "<uuid | null>"
}
```

**Broadcasts:** `new_message` event to all members in the room including sender.
**Error:** `error` event — locked chat, rate limit, non-member.

**Event name to emit:** `user_typing`

Broadcasts a `typing` event to all other members in the group room.

**Payload:**
```json
{ "group_id": "<uuid>" }
```

**Broadcasts:** `typing` → `{ user_id, group_id, display_name }` to all room members except sender.

**Event name to emit:** `heartbeat`

Refreshes the caller's presence TTL in Redis (90 s). Call every ~60 s to stay marked online.

**Payload:** `{}` (empty)

No response event. Side-effect: sets `presence:{userId}` = `1` in Redis with 90 s TTL.

**Event name to emit:** `dm_send`

Send a direct message via socket. Same business rules as `POST /dm/:userId` — shared-group check and block check both enforced.

**Payload:**
```json
{
  "receiver_id": "<uuid>",
  "content": "Hello!",
  "reply_to_id": "<uuid | null>",
  "media_url": "<url | null>"
}
```

**Emits:**
- `dm_received` → to receiver's personal room `user:{receiverId}`
- `dm_received` → echoed back to sender (for multi-device)

**Server → Client events for DM reactions:**
- `dm_reaction_added` → `{ dm_id, emoji, user_id }` emitted to both participant rooms
- `dm_reaction_removed` → `{ dm_id, emoji, user_id }` emitted to both participant rooms

**Error:** `error` event — no shared group, blocked user, empty content.

Body fields:
- `content` (string, optional if media provided): message text, max 4000 chars
- `message_type` (string, optional): `text` | `image` | `file` | `poll` | `voice_note` — defaults to `text`; auto-set to `image` when media file uploaded

- `reply_to_id` (UUID, optional): ID of the message being replied to — must belong to this group

**To send media**, use `multipart/form-data` with field name `media` (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 5 MB).
